style: dark post-apocalyptic, gritty grime and rust, soot black outlines, muted colours with warm lamp light, 16-bit SNES era pixel art, crisp pixels
negative: blurry, smooth gradients, anti-aliasing, bright cheerful colours, text, watermark, frame

prefixes.room_: flat side-view cross-section of one room inside an armoured survival truck: {subject} room, metal walls, floor plate at the bottom, orthographic
prefixes.en_: side-view enemy sprite facing west, mutated wasteland {subject}, full body
prefixes.boss_: side-view boss monster sprite facing west, huge mutated {subject}, full body, menacing
prefixes.lm_: side-view ruined landmark building on the roadside: abandoned {subject}, broken windows, orthographic
prefixes.eng_: side-view truck engine, {subject} engine, pipes and bolts, orthographic
prefixes.turret_: side-view roof-mounted {subject} turret on a truck, facing east
prefixes.ic_: game icon of {subject}, centered, readable at 16 pixels
prefixes.pet_: side-view pet sprite: scruffy wasteland {subject}, facing east
prefixes.veh_: side-view armoured survival {subject} vehicle, orthographic, facing east
